work.summary: Architected and developed high-engagement, lightweight playable mobile ads and interactive 2D gameplay loops adhering to strict ad-network constraints.
highlights: Architected and developed lightweight, interactive playable ads using React.js and modern JavaScript, strictly adhering to ad network performance and file-size constraints.
Engineered complex 2D gameplay loops and interactive mechanics using Phaser.js for high-converting mobile ad experiences.
Integrated Spine 2D skeletal animations, optimizing texture atlases and canvas render calls for smooth 60 FPS mobile performance.
Profiled and optimized asset loading and memory management to minimize load latency and drive conversion rates.

work.summary: Engineered scalable full-stack real estate web applications and backend systems using Laravel, Livewire, and modern responsive frontend frameworks.
highlights: Developed and maintained scalable full-stack web applications using Laravel (PHP), Livewire, MySQL, and built responsive, interactive UIs with JavaScript, Alpine.js, HTML5, CSS3, and Tailwind CSS ensuring performance, maintainability, and a seamless user experience.
Optimized database queries and backend performance, reducing load times and improving system efficiency.
Applied MVC architecture, clean code principles, and reusable components for maintainable development.

work.summary: Trained and validated machine learning and artificial intelligence models through high-precision dataset curation and natural language processing tasks.
highlights: Annotated and labeled large datasets (text, images, and audio) to train and improve machine learning and AI models.
Performed data validation and quality assurance to maintain consistency across datasets.
Worked with natural language processing (NLP) tasks such as text classification, sentiment analysis, and entity tagging.

work.summary: Maintained critical enterprise network infrastructure, hardware switches/routers, and user access protocols following security best practices.
highlights: Installed, configured, and maintained network infrastructure including routers, switches, and LAN/WAN connectivity.
Managed user accounts, permissions, and access control following security best practices.
